name: ncprecinctmap
description: **NCPrecinctMap** is an interactive web-based map for exploring North Carolina election results at the precinct and district level, covering general elections from **2000 through 2024**. It is designed for researchers, journalists, and citizens who want to understand how election results map onto changing precinct and district boundaries over time.
